description: Travel Times for key priority routes 2016-2021 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Queensland Average Travel Times for key priority routes on the state controlled road network broken down in regular intervals. This dataset covers data from 2016 to 2021, for data after 2021 please use the Travel Times for key priority routes 2022 dataset. Coverage: Transport and Main Roads. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are bluetooth, speed, traffic, travel times. It offers 74 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-07-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
